entries.c4aaf44dbf1f4d28: The group's mission is 'work worthy of people', and through the provision of outstanding products it promotes the maximization of advertisers' advertising value and of media companies' revenue in the advertising industries of Japan, North America and Asia. In the advertising business, premium media support is the focus area of its medium-term management plan. In addition to contributing revenue through 'Scarlet' and actively expanding into the video and Connected TV areas and the mobile marketing platform 'Red', its key overseas strategies are to monetize its overseas bases and M&A targets through greater efficiency and to strengthen its revenue base through group synergies. Based on technology assets such as its data analysis platform and machine learning engine, it is also expanding into industries beyond advertising, such as the distribution and retail technology (Retail Tech) field.
